name: @kojo/plugin-ui-snapshot-injector
description: Snapshot injector panel (ui.panel contribution): pick an archive slot, locate scope/variable, edit scalars or cells, preview a before/after diff and confirm injection. The write chain (serialize with raw passthrough + Int64 guard, container assembly, backup, kernel-io write behind both gates, read-back verification) lives in the sav-parser plugin's snapshot.writer service - this plugin is presentation + intent only.
